reuse.why: Extends the existing shared applyWeekendRule and its WeekendRule type, so every caller (preview getNextDate, schedules/app date lists, budget template) picks up holidays without new code.

duplication.why: A single isWeekendOrHoliday predicate is used for both the trigger check and the stepping loop; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend rule already is; only data plumbing (type field, parseRecurDate/getNextDate data) is added elsewhere.

scope.why: Focused on the feature, though the getDatesInRange +/-2 day window in schedules/app.ts, which encodes the old 'at most two days' assumption of this rule, is left untouched.

maintainability.why: Generalising the move into a step loop is clean; the uncoupled two-day window assumption in a caller is a latent trap for maintainers.

one_place.where: applyWeekendRule/isWeekendOrHoliday in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, schedules/app getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange and budget/schedule-template getWeekendAdjustedDay
